title: JOINs at a glance
description: INNER keeps matches only; LEFT keeps every row from the left table.
code:
-- Only users that have orders
SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
INNER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

-- Every user, with orders if any (o.* is NULL when there are none)
SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;

-- Users with NO orders
SELECT u.*
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL;
